channel.title: SV7FSG DX News
channel.description: DXpeditions, special event stations and contests, with dates, bands and QSL info.

item.title: A35TV Tonga 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [28 Nov 2026 – 4 Dec 2026] An international team that includes three Greek operators (SV0EG, SV1DAY, SV1GE) alongside VK2IR, VK3YP and HB9EB will be on the air from Tonga. Activity kicks off with CQ WW DX CW, so listen out for this Pacific operation.

item.title: XR0Z Juan Fernández Is. 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [25 Nov 2026 – 6 Dec 2026] CE3VTZ and XQ7I are heading to remote Alejandro Selkirk Island in the Juan Fernández group. A rare IOTA and a sought-after entity from Europe, with activity also during CQ WW CW.

item.title: 5X7W Uganda 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [8 Nov 2026 – 29 Dec 2026] SM0HPL is already QRV from Uganda for several weeks, using slow CW that is friendly to newer operators. He will also be in CQ WW DX CW and occasionally runs QRP as 5X1Q.

item.title: ZD7WP / ZD7VJ St Helena 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [22 Nov 2026 – 5 Dec 2026] G4BWP (ZD7WP) and 5Z4VJ (ZD7VJ) will operate from St Helena in the South Atlantic on all HF bands including 60m. The island is often workable from Greece, making this a good chance for a band or mode slot.

item.title: XX9TXN Macau 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [24 Nov 2026 – 3 Dec 2026] Italian operator I2VXJ will be QRV from Macau, focusing on the low bands. He plans a single-band entry in CQ WW DX CW.

item.title: VK9XY Christmas Island 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [16 Nov 2026 – 4 Dec 2026] A youth-focused DXpedition with young operators from several countries, run by the Pacific Islands DXpedition Group with Youth on the Air. They'll also be on during CQ WW DX CW, a great chance to log this island.

item.title: C8K Mozambique 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [10 Nov 2026 – 20 Nov 2026] A Czech team is already on the air from Mozambique. SSB has recently started too, with signals on 20m.

item.title: 3X4U Guinea 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [11 Nov 2026 – 24 Nov 2026] Activity from Guinea focusing on the classic modes. ON9CFG is the pilot station.

item.title: ZK3ZL Tokelau 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 18 Nov 2026 – 1 Dec 2026] The team travels by ferry from Samoa and will spend about two weeks on the atoll with multiple HF stations. Exact dates are still to be announced.

item.title: C56XA The Gambia 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [17 Nov 2026 – 1 Dec 2026] G3XAQ will be QRV from The Gambia.

item.title: 3B8/E70A Mauritius 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [20 Nov 2026 – 3 Dec 2026] E70A, a well-known DXpeditioner, will be QRV from Mauritius.

item.title: CQ WW DX CW 2026: dates, bands & DXpeditions to work
item.description: [28 Nov 2026 – 29 Nov 2026] One of the biggest CW contests of the year. Many DXpeditions will be active, so it's a chance for new countries.
